messages:
maya: Heads-up: followed up on the safetensors cold-start flakes. I sketched a different take than the canonical-sidecar RFC we discussed. Wanted quick feedback before I post a PR.

devin: curious. Whats the angle? We already have sidecar proposals floating.

maya: tl;dr: make the sidecar explicitly versioned + lease-validated, and prefer lazy header validation during warmup. Instead of mandatory full-sidecar-read on every cold start, use a two-phase cheap-check then progressive-validate path.

olga: two-phase sounds like what many CDNs do. Explain lease-validated.

maya: flow idea: ingest produces canonical-sidecar.vN.json and writes a small commit-marker file canonical-sidecar.vN.commit which contains {version, header_digest, lease_id}. Writer obtains a short-lived lease token (via metadata service) before renaming into place. Loader sees the .commit and will only pick up bundles whose lease_id is active, avoiding seeing a half-written sidecar.

devin: we already talk about atomic rename to avoid torn views. Lease avoids racey tests on eventual-consistent object stores. Nice. How does loader lazy-validate?

maya: loader fast-path: 1) GET commit file + sidecar meta (small). 2) if commit present and lease valid -> stream first N bytes of header ranges to compute quick digest fragment and compare against commit.header_digest_prefix. If match, stream shards directly. 3) in background, continue streaming the rest of header and full-validate; if later mismatch, mark metric and optionally rollback to fallback route.

olga: so we accept a small window where we might start using a bundle while full-validate is pending. That feels risky for correctness (wrong offsets). How do we avoid corrupted reads?

maya: safety net: commit.header_digest_prefix is computed from canonicalized header truncated to first 32 bytes of SHA256 (base64 URL). That gives strong early signal. Also sidecar contains per-shard offsets+lengths and quick checksums. For each shard read we do range GET and verify shard checksum before using that shard in runtime. If any shard checksum fails we abort request and serve fallback model.

devin: that per-shard verify is key. But extra checksum checks increase latency for small requests that only need first tokens. Maybe we can skip per-shard checksum for shards not yet read into GPU? Like verify lazily as we pull the shard bytes.

maya: yes exactly: lazy verify per chunk. Fast-path is allowed only if headers + first-shard-checksum pass. Otherwise fallback. We record metrics: lazy_fastpath_ok, lazy_fastpath_abort, commit_lease_missing.

harry: question: who manages lease tokens? Is this infra-only (S3 object metadata) or integrated with our control plane?

maya: proposal: control plane issues ephemeral lease ids during ingest. We write lease id into commit file and also annotate object-store metadata. Lease lives ~30s, long enough to commit and have clients pick up, short to avoid stale claims. If ingestion stalls we abort and leave no .commit.

olga: what about cross-region reads where metadata visibility may lag? Lease approach might false-negative.

maya: add a backoff: if loader sees no commit but finds bundle object, it can optionally try a heuristic: fetch small header ranges + compare to last-known canonical digest from registry; if matches, proceed but mark metric 'heuristic_no_commit'. Default disallowed for enterprise tenants unless opted in.

devin: we need clear compatibility rules: old bundles without sidecar must still work. How do we detect that?

maya: loader behavior summary: 1) sidecar+commit present -> sidecar flows above. 2) commit absent but bundle exists -> legacy fallback: full header parse + normal streaming. 3) commit present but lease expired -> treat as not-ready and fallback to legacy or retry per-config.

harry: CI note: we should add tests that simulate eventual consistency plus duplicate/partial uploads (S3 incoherence). I can add integration scenarios in the harness.

ci-bot: build 4312 triggered: feat/lazy-sidecar-tests - integration suite queued.

olga: ops concerns: ingestion now depends on control-plane lease service; we must make that highly available. Also need to document error codes so load balancers can route fallback to secondary model variant instead of failing customer request.

maya: agreed. Ops action: add lease service runbook + graceful degradation (retry windows + fallback model). Also add metric 'sidecar_commits_per_min' and 'sidecar_lease_failures'.

devin: implementation note: sidecar schema should include canonical_header_version, header_digest_prefix (base64url), per_shard {id, offset, length, checksum_b64}, and optionally delta_base_version for patching. Keep schema tiny (<4KB) for cheap GETs.

olga: patching: if we support delta patches, commit must include a base_version field and explicit patch manifest listing shard diffs. Loader needs to ensure delta_base_version matches the running canonical digest before applying patch.

maya: correct. We'll also add a policy: delta patches are only allowed for bundles <certain size and only for customers with Dedicated where we control exporter. Public exporters remain full-rewrite.

devin: can we compress sidecar with brotli? Saves GETs. But some object stores charge differently. Maybe optional Content-Encoding header.

maya: optional. Schema must include encoding field so loader can decompress. Default no-encoding to be simple.

olga: OK, I like this. Suggest we dogfood in staging with a feature flag: lazy-validate enabled + commit-lease required. Then measure cold-start latencies.

maya: plan to open RFC PR with schema, ingest pseudo-code, loader state transitions, and test matrix. Will include sample scripts for exporters to obtain lease and write commit.

devin: add a small snippet for per-shard lazy verify pseudocode in RFC so runtime folks can wire it easily.

maya: snippet I'll include: 
```
# pseudo loader fast-path
commit = GET(sidecar.commit)
if commit and lease_ok(commit.lease_id):
  side = GET(sidecar)
  if side.header_digest_prefix == quick_digest_range(header_bytes):
    stream_shard_ranges()
    for shard in streamed_shards:
      if not verify_checksum(shard):
        metric.inc('lazy_fastpath_abort')
        abort_and_fallback()
    background_full_validate()
  else:
    fallback_full_parse()
else:
  fallback_full_parse()
```

harry: I'll add tests for commit races + expired leases. Also test delta patch apply and revert.

ci-bot: integration job 4312 started. Will report back.

maya: thanks all. If no objections I'll file RFC + initial tests tomorrow. Reopen thread if anything else crops up.
